founder_protocol: Four-gate protocol supplied in the current conversation; no canonical ratification inferred.

required_inputs: Complete owner-designated candidate corpus bytes and source registry
Source revisions, standing, Founder intention, jurisdiction, epoch and lineage
Prior admission dependencies and affected-example inventory
procedure: Resolve actual source inventory and finalized independently verified target list.
Apply all full-admission obligations before including any row in the admitted manifest.
Use exact core fields example_id, source_revision, reviewed_target, lineage_group and assigned_split; permitted splits are train, regression_dev and holdout.
Keep missing, unverified or unresolved submissions in a separate PENDING_ADMISSION ledger.
Materialize a nonempty admitted manifest only after target finalization and row admission; produce a detached SHA-256 digest.
Verify independent review, prior admission dependencies and required requalification; no manifest or target list is supplied by this correction.
acceptance_evidence: Nonempty corpus manifest, raw corpus bytes and manifest digest
Inventory completeness review and authenticated requalification receipts
gates.seal_limits: Digest binds exact bytes; it does not authenticate source, prove completeness or admit examples.

required_inputs: Actual target outputs and invariant labels
Reviewer identity and independently pinned authentication method
Evidence that reviewer and target review are independent of development fixtures
procedure: Review target correctness, source standing, applicable equivalence and acceptable abstention before subject-model exposure.
Resolve disputed labels; hold unresolved targets.
Bind each review to exact input, source, target, rubric and context digests.
Authenticate reviews against separately established trust anchors; self-asserted reviewer names are insufficient.
acceptance_evidence: Authenticated independent review receipts and target inventory

required_inputs: Fresh independently authored cases outside every excluded family
Complete ancestry, duplication and exposure records
Separate evaluator custody and verifiable access controls
procedure: Resolve transitive source/conversation/correction lineage before model, prompting or repair-cycle exposure.
Restrict all ten repair-family origins and derivatives and all 66 known development cases to regression_dev; prohibit them from train and holdout.
Freeze exact train/regression_dev/holdout membership and authenticate a detached signature over the bound payload.
Keep held-out material completely unexposed throughout active iteration; use detached evaluator custody and verify access/exposure controls.
Disclose held-out inputs to the subject only in the separately bound final evaluation; keep oracle targets and review receipts outside subject context and retrieval.
Retire any exposed or lesson-admitted case from freshness claims, preserve its historical result, and create a separately reviewed successor holdout.
acceptance_evidence: Reviewed lineage-separated holdout manifest and detached digests
Custody/access test evidence and exposure log
Frozen task family coverage, sample counts and statistical/acceptance plan
gates.coverage_limits: Excluding entire known defect families narrows the fresh-holdout claim; those families retain development-regression evidence only.

required_inputs: Actual candidate runtime and protected recipient implementation
Recipient-local admission policy and independently bound verifier
Resource envelope, isolation, durability boundary and covered crash model
Effect-history observation and trusted receipt issuance
procedure: Freeze applicable runtime obligations, fixture mapping and pass/fail criteria before execution.
Exercise the actual bound protected boundary; a newly authored mock cannot establish an unbound candidate runtime.
Observe decision order and the full covered effect history, including compensated effects.
Adjudicate structural preservation, interpretive fidelity and authority enforcement independently.
acceptance_evidence: Runtime-bound authoritative order and effect-history traces
Authenticated per-obligation verdict receipts and scope limitations

obligations.criterion: Receiving or verifying a proposal alone grants no authority. Absent or rejected recipient-local admission yields no protected effect.

R precedes D in the authoritative order implies finalized REJECT and no protected commitment or forbidden effect. Exercise both race schedules and adjudicate the actual order; timestamps are diagnostic.
Pin the admission/commit atomicity rule. Successful retries do not duplicate protected effects; unfinished attempts are not relabeled as rejection.
A different recipient, scope or epoch cannot reuse the authority. Verify covered bypass paths cannot mutate protected state.
After the pinned cease event, no new protected effects occur within the covered boundary; report disposition of in-flight work.
Test the declared crash/durability boundary and recovery behavior. A later compensation does not erase an earlier forbidden effect.
Bind attempted input, decision, commitment, revocation/cease state, ordering and observed effects to authenticated exact-artifact receipts.

verdict_policy.not_applicable: Requires predeclared applicability and remains separate from PASS

gates.promotion_limits: A scoped local runtime pass does not establish production enforcement or confer deployment authority.

supersedes_for_future_schema_use.preservation: Exact v0.1 bytes archived; no prior evidence is rewritten.
